implementation.targetScope: KeyboardEvent.key normalization, exported legacy key-code tables, Mac/legacy modifier behavior and current/app ProseMirror keymap 1.2.3 compatibility. Tiptap native Chrome keyboard dispatch is checked; operating-system keyboard layouts and full editor adoption remain separate.

changes: Independent implementation with zero dependencies. Upstream runtime source is not shipped.
Reads event.key once and uses tables without Object.prototype inheritance; exported numeric entries remain mutable.
Preserves current key values, legacy aliases, key-code fallbacks and platform modifier behavior. Historical fallback tables remain US-layout based.
